question: Can within-store template-family hold-out (train on N tasks of a family, test on held-out tasks of same family) on WebArena-Verified v2 single shopping store provide identifiable same-mechanism parameterized transfer for C-LLM-INHERIT, and does Mind2Web cross-website splits show measurable same-mechanism overlap when inspected at task-sample accessibility-tree level — quantifying duplication fraction, parameterization prevalence and cross-task mechanism overlap to resolve documentation-assumed VF5/VF6 and design true website-holdout?
hypothesis: H1_WEB_HOLDOUT: WebArena-Verified v2 single shopping store (192 tasks, 49 intent_templates, single container am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping) possesses sufficient within-store parameterized family structure for identifiable same-mechanism hold-out: family-reuse fraction >=0.5, task-level parameterization prevalence >=0.3, exact-copy fraction <0.2, at least 5 families with >=3 tasks each, and sampled accessibility-tree mechanism consistency >=0.6 (same intent_template maps to same AX role/element pattern across tasks of same family). H2_MIND2WEB_OVERLAP: Mind2Web cross-website splits (train vs test_website vs test_domain, 137 websites / 31 domains, ~2350 tasks) contain measurable same-mechanism overlap when inspected at task-sample level: mechanism-overlap fraction |M_test_website intersect M_train| / |M_test_website| >=0.15 and exceeds shuffled-website null by >=0.10, with measured duplication fraction and parameterization prevalence disclosing heuristic M2 inflation (audit VF2). Mechanism is defined strictly as intent_template (WebArena) or normalized operation-template cluster (Mind2Web) — not site label — enabling sample-level verification of VF5/VF6 that documentation alone could not provide.
falsifier: ANY of: (F1) WebArena family-reuse fraction <0.5 OR parameterization prevalence <0.3 OR exact-copy fraction >=0.2 indicating verbatim copy rather than parameterized reuse; (F2) fewer than 5 template families contain >=3 tasks (no hold-out axis), OR fewer than 3 families contain >=4 tasks for 2-train/1-test viability; (F3) Sampled AX consistency <0.6 (same template maps to disparate element patterns) or positive control fails (search mechanism absent); (F4) Mind2Web cross-website overlap fraction <0.15 OR not exceeding shuffled null by >=0.10 (no same-mechanism transfer across websites); (F5) Dataset divergence: WebArena-Verified v2 task census differs from frozen 192/49 or Mind2Web HuggingFace snapshot is unavailable/corrupt (BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID guard). A valid negative on F1-F4 is a scientific falsification in this setting, not infrastructure failure; infrastructure unavailability triggers BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not FALSIFIED.

baselines.description: Documentation-level M1=1.0 cross-site structure for WebArena shopping (12 store instances from WebArena v1 docs, EXP-INTEL-35651934683). Falsified for WebArena-Verified v2 as REJECTED in parent handoff: exactly one store exists in all three v2 dataset files and live container. Retained as strong falsification baseline to prevent re-inflation.
baselines.expected: M1=1.0 if v2 contained 12 stores; measured as vacuous null (not 0.0) with single store. This experiment replaces M1 with within-store family-reuse metric.

baselines.description: Heuristic M2=0.80 parameterization (scoring-rule heuristic from EXP-INTEL-35651934683, audit VF2 flagged as not measured) and corrected Mind2Web M1=0.8182 inflated vs 0.311 empirical. This experiment reports measured fractions via instantiation_dict non-empty (WebArena) and operation-slot analysis (Mind2Web).
baselines.expected: Parent measured 0.8958 task-level / 0.8367 template-level on 192 tasks; heuristic gap and bootstrap CI [0.9167,0.9792] duplication disclosed. Mind2Web M2 inflated 2.6x via hardcoded max vs mean websites/domain.

baselines.description: SPIDER 2-site corpus (quotes + books) lower bound: 2 sites, no controlled novelty splits, minimal parameterized reuse. Any viable within-store or cross-website mechanism must exceed this bound.
baselines.expected: 2-site corpus has fewer cross-task mechanisms than WebArena single-store families (39/49 reuse families) and fewer cross-website mechanisms than Mind2Web 137 sites.

baselines.description: Shuffled-identity null: randomize template-family assignment (WebArena) or website assignment (Mind2Web) and recompute overlap/reuse. Same-mechanism signal must exceed this null to be attributable to mechanism sharing, not label frequency. For Mind2Web, shuffle websites across train/test_website and recompute overlap; for WebArena, shuffle instantiation_dict or template labels.
baselines.expected: Shuffled overlap ~ chance (~0 for well-separated sites; ~duplication baseline for families). True overlap must exceed shuffled by >=0.10 (Mind2Web) and AX consistency must drop under shuffle.

baselines.description: Strong retrieval/replay baseline framing for product design: exact template replay gives 90ms/0-token economics for stable tasks (TERX/HyperAgent 23k->0 tokens, 173x) but fails on novel identifiers. Within-store hold-out must be evaluated against this baseline in future Product experiment; this Intel experiment quantifies substrate viability, not LLM benefit.
baselines.expected: Not executed here; disclosed to prevent conflating measured family reuse (0.9479 duplication) with inheritance benefit. Product lane tests cold vs retrieval vs SPIDER conditional on this substrate.

positive_control: PC1_WEB_SEARCH: homepage accessibility tree (CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree, initial viewport 1280x720) contains combobox 'Search' + button 'Search' and DOM input#search placeholder 'Search entire store here...' with form action /catalogsearch/result/ — must PASS on live single store (replicated from parent PC1 PASS on task 514, 1426 nodes). PC2_MIND2WEB_SEARCH: Mind2Web train tasks contain at least one recurring operation-template cluster (e.g., search TYPE) that appears in >=10 tasks across >=3 websites, confirming mechanism recurrence is detectable in dataset. Failure of PC1/PC2 indicates sampling or parsing error, not scientific falsification.
null_control: NC1_WIKIPEDIA_NULL: Wikipedia site-type (if Docker available, guarded) contains no shopping mechanisms (search-for-product, add-to-cart, checkout). Expected 0 shopping overlap; NOT EXERCISED if container absent — report as null, not 0. NC2_MIND2WEB_SHUFFLE_NULL: shuffled website assignment null for Mind2Web cross-website overlap (see B4). NC2 must show overlap drop to near-zero; if observed overlap equals shuffled overlap, same-mechanism transfer is not demonstrated. NC3_WEB_EXACT_COPY_NULL: exact-copy fraction (identical template AND instantiation_dict) must remain low (<0.2) while duplication fraction high — distinguishes parameterized reuse from verbatim copy (parent 0.0781 vs 0.9479). NC3 fails if exact copies dominate.
measurement_validity: WebArena-Verified v2 dataset pinned to ServiceNow/WebArena-Verified commit ef74e1bfd0d83d4bab1c55b2d1b4c2aeaac8e0d0, local sha256 d65275660814663375028e9017e1f929e3c38321041b125795e2713b52243d30 (812 tasks). Shopping census must be recomputed and match 192 tasks / 49 templates or report divergence explicitly.

Mind2Web dataset pinned to HuggingFace osu-nlp/Mind2Web (NeurIPS 2023, 137 websites, 31 domains) via datasets library; record dataset revision hash, split census (train / test_task / test_website / test_domain) and task counts. If HF unavailable, report BLOCKED with durable error and do not substitute documentation.

Mechanism identity is frozen BEFORE measurement: WebArena mechanism = intent_template string; Mind2Web mechanism = normalized operation-template cluster (action_type + target-role + intent verb lemma, e.g., CLICK-searchbox / TYPE-query), clustered deterministically with frozen seed 35725763380. No post hoc redefinition after seeing overlap.

Accessibility-tree verification is initial-viewport CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree only (matches parent; Playwright 1.63 page.accessibility removed). Sample at least 15 tasks stratified across >=10 families (2 tasks per family where family size >=2) to compute AX consistency. Below-fold/post-checkout not measured — explicitly excluded and disclosed.

Frozen seed 35725763380 for all sampling, bootstrapping (2000 reps for 95% CIs), and shuffle permutations (1000 perms). Preprocessing (parsing JSON, clustering) fit on train only where applicable; no test leakage into cluster definitions.

Raw artifacts preserved with sha256: webarena-verified.json, Mind2Web split JSONs, sampled AX trees (if Docker available; else reuse parent AX trees with provenance and label as reused, not re-extracted), derived measurements.json and bootstrap_ci.json. Docker image digest recorded if live extraction performed (am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945ea9b1c94ab26dba53e8d12dd0406abbf4bf686fd3bb2b6a5908feb).

Representation loss disclosure: AX node counts, viewport-only limitation, intent_template granularity, Mind2Web element_id vs semantic role mapping, and instantiation_dict vs string-matching parameterization all documented. Do not claim LLM inheritance benefit from this measurement alone.
decision_rule: Frozen five-clause rule evaluated in order: (0) Infrastructure gate: if WebArena JSON sha mismatch irreconcilable or Mind2Web HF dataset unavailable/auth-blocked and no local cache, verdict=MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED with durable error (not FALSIFIED). (1) WebArena within-store axis: if family_reuse_fraction <0.5 OR parameterization_task_fraction <0.3 OR exact_copy_fraction >=0.2 OR families_with_>=3_tasks <5 OR AX_consistency <0.6 OR PC1 fails, then that axis is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for within-store hold-out viability. (2) Mind2Web cross-website axis: if overlap_fraction <0.15 OR (overlap_fraction - shuffled_overlap) <0.10 OR parameterization_prevalence <0.15, then that axis is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for same-mechanism cross-website transfer. (3) If both axes pass all thresholds AND NC2/NC3 behave as expected (shuffled overlap low, exact copies low) AND bootstrap CIs exclude threshold by >=0.05 margin, verdict=SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (within-store hold-out is identifiable same-mechanism substrate; Mind2Web provides measurable cross-website overlap for future website-holdout design). (4) If one axis passes and the other is FALSIFIED, verdict=MIXED with per-axis bounded ceiling (declare which transfer axis is viable). (5) If duplication fraction >=0.9 but exact-copy <0.2, do NOT trigger MIXED as in parent; parent MIXED duplication clause is superseded — high duplication here is expected parameterized family reuse, not copy dilution, and is distinguished via NC3. All thresholds are frozen; no post hoc relaxation.
product_consequence_positive: SURVIVES: Product/Graph lane can design within-store template-family hold-out for C-LLM-INHERIT on WebArena-Verified v2 single store (192 tasks, 49 families) — train on N tasks per family, test on held-out tasks of same family with frozen seed, measuring parameterized resolution success vs literal/retrieval baselines (cold vs retrieval vs SPIDER) under strong 0-token replay framing. Mind2Web measurable overlap (>=0.15, exceeds shuffle) green-lights parallel website-holdout design for C-CROSSSITE (train on N websites, test on held-out websites sharing same mechanism cluster). Both designs can proceed without re-assuming 12-store cross-site structure.
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIED WebArena axis: within-store family hold-out not identifiable (too few families, low parameterization, or AX inconsistency) — C-LLM-INHERIT cannot use WebArena-Verified v2 shopping single-store families as same-mechanism testbed; Product must stay bounded to 2-site corpus or pursue Mind2Web-only website-holdout. FALSIFIED Mind2Web axis: cross-website overlap ~shuffle null — C-CROSSSITE website-holdout not demonstrably same-mechanism; future website-holdout must be limited to within-store families or custom benchmark construction. MIXED: proceed only on surviving axis; do not claim cross-site if only within-store survives.
estimated_cost: LOW: no LLM API calls, no Docker required for WebArena census (reuse parent digest if live extraction not repeated; optional 1 Docker run for 15 AX trees ~30 min). Mind2Web HF download ~1GB, parsing/clustering ~10 min, bootstrap 2000 reps ~5 min. Total compute <2h, storage <3GB /tmp, no network beyond HF/Docker Hub. Stdlib + datasets + playwright optional.
expected_information_gain: HIGH: Resolves two blocking audit findings VF5/VF6 at task-sample level that documentation surveys could not: (1) quantifies whether single-store WebArena provides identifiable same-mechanism axis (39/49 reuse, 0.8958 param previously measured but not AX-verified or hold-out enumerated); (2) measures whether Mind2Web cross-website splits actually share mechanisms or merely guarantee unseen websites — prerequisite for any C-LLM-INHERIT vs cold/retrieval/SPIDER and C-CROSSSITE website-holdout without leakage. A clean positive unlocks the highest-leverage untested product promise; a clean negative prevents investing LLM costs on a vacuous cross-site design (parent 12-store artifact). Information gain is portfolio-level, not marginal on synthetic DGP.
